verdict.rationale: Drata documents an Evidence Library API with create, update, and versioning of evidence items, plus custom workflow triggers and actions that monitor controls and evidence. Together these suggest a home for manual artifacts and some automation around them, but none of the evidence explicitly describes owner assignment, due dates, renewal reminders, or expiry tracking for manual evidence. Missing for 10: documented owner assignment on manual evidence, due dates, renewal/reminder notifications, expiry tracking, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
